name: rf_torun_bydgoszcz_2025_4class
labels: 2025 maps of the reference project for Torun and Bydgoszcz (series A built-up land and four-class model, label transfer from Dynamic World 2025), 30 m, EPSG:2180
points_note: 750 per class and city, seeds 42 and 43
feature_note: NDVI amplitude excluded: unstable between epochs (Grudziadz 1985 test and Torun/Bydgoszcz)
cross_city_transfer_note: model trained on one city (1500 points per class, seed 7) and evaluated on 5000 points per class of the other city (seed 8); overall accuracy, binary model at threshold 0.65
